title: IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow an authenticated privileged attacker to send unauthorized…
description: IBM API Connect versions 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated privileged attacker to send unauthorized requests from the system. This vulnerability may enable the attacker to enumerate network resources or facilitate further attacks. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.8 and does not have known exploits in the wild.
